## Help wanted: classify another MCP server

The registry covers 20 servers. There are many more. Adding one is the best first contribution, and it takes about an hour for a small server.

Good candidates, by popularity and by how interesting their reversibility questions are:
- [ ] Linear
- [ ] Atlassian (Jira / Confluence)
- [ ] Cloudflare
- [ ] AWS (any of the awslabs servers)
- [ ] MongoDB
- [ ] Redis — claimed by @adity982 (redis/mcp-redis)
- [ ] Figma
- [ ] Google Drive / Gmail

How: follow [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/waghmaredb/reversibility-classes/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md). The two rules are that every tool name must be verified against a primary source (prefer the source code; READMEs drift), and every class needs a one-sentence reason.

Comment here with the server you're taking so two people don't do the same one.
